name: Suzuki B100P / B105P Magnum / Bearcat 120
engine: 118 cc air-cooled rotary-valve two-stroke single, Posi-Force oil injection
intro: Suzuki's early 120 cc singles sold in the US. Simple, light and now rare.

G: Check the oil injection: the tank feeds the pump, the lines are bled, and the pump cable opens with the throttle.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
